name: SCO Dimension of Singletons
proof: For $n\geq3$, the spherical dimension of singletons is 1, so Theorem 12 gives $\mathrm{SCO}\geq2$.  Their sign rank is 2 at n=3 and 3 for $n\geq4$; the sign-rank construction in the same theorem gives the corresponding upper bounds.  Thus n=3 is exact, while the displayed interval is established for larger n.
